description: This file defines a ServerMetrics struct and associated methods for monitoring gRPC server metrics using Prometheus, including counters, histograms, and interceptors.

classes.name: ServerMetrics
classes.description: A collection of Prometheus metrics for monitoring gRPC server activity, including counters and histograms, with methods for registration and interceptors.

methods.name: NewServerMetrics
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ServerMetrics object with configured counters, histograms, and labels.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Sends all metric descriptors to the provided channel for Prometheus collection.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Collects and sends all metrics to the provided channel for Prometheus.

methods.name: InitializeMetrics
methods.description: Pre-registers metrics for all gRPC methods on the server to ensure they exist for collection.

methods.name: preRegisterMethod
methods.description: Pre-registers metrics for a specific gRPC method with empty label values.

methods.name: UnaryServerInterceptor
methods.description: Returns a gRPC unary server interceptor for Prometheus metrics collection.

methods.name: StreamServerInterceptor
methods.description: Returns a gRPC stream server interceptor for Prometheus metrics collection.
